coverage: Read the complete available local article body; linked images, videos and external claims not independently inspected.
basis: Practitioner account / proposed exercise; no direct causal evaluation of the extracted practice.
reported_outcomes: Six proposed workflows and disclosure that AI wrote half the post.
limits: The cited studies do not directly test these workflows. Generated reasoning is not guaranteed access to internal computation; scores and guessed prompts do not verify learning or intent. Human-first variants overlap better-bounded sources elsewhere.
review_note: Mixes draft-first and retrieval ideas with iterate-until-AI-score-8, purported private-reasoning access and reverse-prompt guessing.
author: Ruben Hassid
